Marin (Marketing): Heads-up — we're lining up the public release next Thurs. Need final bits from eng/docs so comms and webinar invites can be locked:
- Short changelog bullets we can paste into the post (1 line each)
- Permanent doc links and migration note anchor IDs
- Confirm safe-to-publish benchmark numbers + link to public notebook
- Exact rollout schedule (TZ) and canary policy so we can time press/social/webinar
Also need webhook payload sample for inbound trial routing to Sales. Can we freeze text by EOD tomorrow?

Theo (Eng): Yes, freeze by EOD tomorrow is fine. Current rollout plan: Canary: 2027-06-09 03:00 UTC (30m), 10% -> 40% -> 100% by 05:00 UTC. No API surface changes (config-only). Changelog bullets below.

Theo (Eng): Changelog lines (use verbatim):```
- Reduced p95 token generation latency via adaptive KV cache prioritization
- Added lightweight INT4 runtime path for cost-sensitive inference
- Resolved a concurrency issue in request coalescing under burst load
```
Commits: 9f8e7d..c3b2a1

Omar (Benchmarks): Publishable summaries: p50 (512 tokens) = 95ms on V100-dedicated, relative cost reduction = 34%. Public notebook (trimmed): https://benchmarks.redwood.ai/public/v2-4-notebook. Owner for follow-ups: Omar.

Rina (Docs): I'll publish the docs and give permalinks by afternoon:
- Release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes#v2-4.1
- Upgrade guide anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/upgrade#kv-cache
- Migration diff: https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/v2-4
I'll also add an FAQ section tailored for webinar questions.

Marin (Marketing): Great — webhook payload for signups? We need to route trials@ and tag by model variant/utm.

Theo (Eng): Sample POST to /webhooks/signup (JSON):```json
{
  "email":"j@example.com",
  "org":"Example Inc",
  "plan":"trial-30d",
  "model_variant":"int4-lite",
  "utm_source":"linkedin",
  "utm_medium":"paid",
  "utm_campaign":"v2_4_launch"
}
```
We'll deliver to trials@redwood.com. If you want explicit routing tags, add "tags":["enterprise","ml-startup"] and we'll populate from signup form.

webhook-bot: Webhook subscription created for /webhooks/signup -> trials@redwood.com

Marin (Marketing): Timing note: we'll publish blog at 05:10 UTC (5m after full rollout) and run a live webinar same day at 17:00 UTC. Can the eng oncall be on standby for the demo?

Theo (Eng): Yes, I'll schedule an oncall engineer for the webinar window and post canary logs to the playbook channel if anything unusual shows. No embargo conflicts from infra.

Marin (Marketing): Perfect. I'll draft the blog with the exact bullets and the benchmark link. I'll also prepare UTM templates and share social copy for review in this thread by tomorrow AM. Ping here if anything changes. :sparkles:
